items.title: The fix for CVE-2026-6460 is not complete when you upgrade the server.
Over 140 bug fixes, several of them silent-wrong-answer or corruption class.
The planner's join-removal implementation was reworked in a minor release — the notes concede this is "a significant change for an update release", done to stop recurring wrong-results bugs.
tzdata 2026f is in this release, closing both live axes: Cuba staying on DST this winter, and year-round UTC-06 for America/Inuvik / UTC-05 for America/Winnipeg.
14.25 is the final PostgreSQL 14 release.
PostgreSQL 19 GA is planned for 2026-11-19 (5 days out), and RC 2 shipped 2026-11-12. Vendor wording is "should be made generally available", conditional on no further blocker.
If you have been testing 19, RC 2 contains a revert that breaks your upgrade path.

All three major managed Postgres services are exactly one minor behind, so the 52-CVE batch is unavailable everywhere.
MySQL Server 8.0 gets nothing, and the CPU risk matrix makes that look like safety.
